text: Security is a vital part of web development. First, websites should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, protecting sensitive information like passwords. Second, authentication ensures that only authorized users can access certain areas, usually through strong passwords or two-factor authentication. Third, developers must validate all input to prevent attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Common vulnerabilities often come from weak code, so regular testing and updates are essential. By focusing on these practices, developers can build safer websites and protect both users and data from online threats.
